target.statement: Reproduce the qualitative validation result that the reference-performance dataset is internally coherent: compressor outlet air temperature vs compressor pressure ratio shows a clear monotonic trend across the 30-90% load range (Fig. 6a), i.e., a positive monotonic relationship between T15 and Pturb in Reference_Data.csv.

compute.basis: The paper releases only CSV data plus metadata (no code); the target is a simple monotonic-trend check on a small reference CSV, so an agent can download the Zenodo archive, parse the multi-row header, and compute a correlation/plot in minutes on a CPU.

blockers: No code released (paper states 'No custom code is associated with the released dataset'), so parsing/plotting must be written from scratch
Multi-row headers and mixed units (some pressures in volts) require care in column mapping
Target is a qualitative validation figure, not a quantitative benchmark number
title: Marine Engine Fault Dataset: Open-Access Data under Controlled Reference and Fault Scenario Conditions
